correctness.rationale: The five partial derivatives give a square-zero graded quotient with a two-term free presentation. Its determinant remains nonzero modulo every prime, proving fibrewise injectivity and Z-flatness. Matrix factorization along the smooth conic gives O_P1(-1) in odd characteristic; modulo two the cokernel is two copies of O_line(-1). The Hilbert section count follows from these explicit sheaves. The included verifier independently corroborates derivative ideals and Hilbert functions in several characteristics.

value.rationale: The specified Perazzo cubic is the foundational nonconical Hessian-zero example, with its reduced singular plane known for over a century. An exact characteristic-sensitive degeneration of the full polar base-locus structure—from one nilpotent conic-supported line bundle to two nilpotent line-supported summands—is a natural geometric invariant not determined by that support. The sheaf, flatness and global Hilbert data give a meaningful complete classification for this fixed integral object without alleging a broader resolution theorem.
